# Repair list - the 120 rows that never ran

**Generated by `tools/blocked_triage.py --probe --list`.** Regenerate it rather than editing it.

None of these rows has been judged: freqtrade would not start them, so no gate ever saw them. That makes the question here different from everywhere else in this audit. It is not *is this strategy sound* but *would repairing it restore what the author wrote, or supply what they did not*.

Freqtrade reports most load failures as `Impossible to load Strategy 'X'. This class does not exist or contains Python code errors`, which names none of the three things it could be. Each file was therefore imported directly in the pinned runtime and the real exception recorded; that is what the families below are built from.

## `to_be_fixed` - 26 strategies

What stops the row is ours, or is the author's own words under a name the framework has since changed. Repairing it restores what they wrote.
